answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges, fading each hop like an echo. An identity reached only by a long thin path earns little; a fake cluster grafted on at the zenith of the fringe inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers who stake their own standing. Minting a plume of fakes with no real inbound edges from the core buys no influence.
